asset.name: DataQueryAdapter
asset.description: Connects typed data-source ports to a query and cache layer, direct fetchers, subscriptions, or offline storage, without any component learning how data arrives.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: The seam that keeps the library out of the data-fetching business. Components accept data, actions, and conditions; where those come from is entirely the scenario's concern.
